title: JUDGEMENT - THE TESTIMONY OF THE TWO WITNESSES

sense.text:
“And ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars: see that ye be not troubled”. The key is that when you see these things happening, you do not worry and fret over what is taking place. You work on getting yourself right.

“For all these things must come to pass, but the end is not yet.” People keep saying war is coming, Russia is about to do this or that. No. The end is not yet.

“For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be famines, and pestilences, and earthquakes, in divers places.” These are the times we are living in right now. The world has changed, and it is not going to be the same.

“All these are the beginning of sorrows.” We are living, brothers and sisters, in the beginning of sorrows. It is only the beginning. What is taking place on the earth is not going to get better and it is not going to go away. The Democrats are not going to come into office and change things and make it better. God says it is the beginning of sorrows.

precepts.why:
Ezra shows why it is only the beginning: “For yet greater evils than those which thou hast seen happen shall be done hereafter.” There are much greater evils yet to take place on this earth.

“For look how much the world shall be weaker through age, so much the more shall evils increase upon them that dwell therein.” The older the world gets, the weaker it becomes, and we are at the end of it right now. That evil is war, death and destruction, and it is going to increase.

So the time we are living in is the beginning of sorrows. It is not going to get better, and that is why you have to prepare for what is coming.

sense.text: “Beloved, think it not strange concerning the fiery trial which is to try you, as though some strange thing happened unto you”. The fiery trials are there to try us. Do not act like something strange happened to you when you are being persecuted or going through trials. Why are bad things happening to me? Why am I sick? Why am I going through these things? Because you are a son of God and you were called. It is the Lord trying you. You do not sit down and cry and wonder why.

“But rejoice, inasmuch as ye are partakers of Christ’s sufferings”. Why is the government coming after my husband? Why is the government labeling us a hate group, when we don’t hate nobody? It is because we are partakers in Christ’s sufferings, “that, when his glory shall be revealed, ye may be glad also with exceeding joy.” The only way you will be glad then is if you take part in that suffering now.

“If ye be reproached for the name of Christ, happy are ye; for the spirit of glory and of God resteth upon you”. That is, if you be hated for the name of Christ. Once you follow Christ and teach this gospel you are going to go through bad things. They will hate you for teaching the gospel and for confessing Christ on this earth, and you will be hated by your own nation.

“For the time is come that judgment must begin at the house of God”. Judgment always starts with the house of God; it always starts with us. In ancient time God raised up Nebuchadnezzar and sent him to judge the nations, and he started with Israel, with Judah. He destroyed us, and then he poured out on Egypt and on all nations. That was God’s judgment.

“And if it first begin at us, what shall the end be of them that obey not the gospel of God?” That is why this matters. Look at what is happening in the streets of America to blacks, Hispanics and North American Indians. The ICE raids are in the black and Hispanic communities, not in the European communities. Some ask why Trump is doing these things. A man’s goings are of the Lord: God put the spirit on Trump to do what he is doing, and the Bible has the answer why.

It is not because the Lord just doesn’t like his people. Judgment starts at the house of God for two reasons: first, for us to turn back to our God and seek him; and second, to prove us. As you turn to him, bad things will still happen to you, to prove whether you believe and trust in him.

“And if the righteous scarcely be saved, where shall the ungodly and the sinner appear?” If the righteous scarcely be saved, a lot of righteous brothers and sisters will die when that judgment comes. Don’t think, Oh, I’m righteous, nothing will happen to me. Judgment starts at the house of God, and righteous men will die also.

“Wherefore let them that suffer according to the will of God commit the keeping of their souls to him in well doing”. It is the will of God for some of us to suffer and go through certain things. So you must be in well doing: keep the commandments, do what is right, and get rid of the adultery, the fornication and all these things.

precepts.why:
This is why God’s judgment starts at the house of God first. “Arise ye, and depart; for this is not your rest: because it is polluted, it shall destroy you”. God says this place is polluted, and this place will destroy us.

For over sixty years our people in the Caribbean islands, in Africa and here in America got comfortable. Ever since they gave us civil rights, and the Caucasians here said they would not lynch us openly anymore and would let us integrate and assimilate into their system, we became comfortable. In the ’20s, ’30s, ’40s and ’50s we knew who our enemy was. Sixty years ago we were marching, No justice, no peace, and Treat us as men, we are not animals. Today we have forgotten, and think America is the place of opportunity, rights, love and justice.

Our people forgot that this is the land of their captivity, and forgot who the oppressor is. So God says, I am going to show you who your enemy is. The Most High said, Mr. white man, show blacks and Hispanics who you really are. That is why you see what you see going on in the world today: ICE in Minneapolis shooting at our people, a six-month-old baby left lifeless in tear gas, US citizens beaten and detained. Christians are telling people to join ICE and become God’s appointed avenger, and make white Jesus smile; and a lot of these agents are racist, KKK and Nazis, racist Christian nationalists. It was never about jobs.

Our people are realizing the American dream is exactly what it is, a dream. There is no such thing as justice and equal rights here. That is judgment starting first at the house of God.

“He delivereth the poor in his affliction, and openeth their ears in oppression.” When our people are being oppressed, God opens their ears.

All the things you see Trump and ICE doing in the black community are God opening your ears, because you have been lost and confused here in America, following the American dream and thinking America is about equal rights and opportunity. God said, No, this place is not your rest. I will turn up oppression on my people, because the only time we as a people turn to God and try to seek him is when bad things start happening to us. In oppression is the only time we open our ears and want to hear God. So God says, I am going to let Trump oppress you all, for you to start listening to me.

“I will go and return to my place, till they acknowledge their offence, and seek my face: in their affliction they will seek me early.” In our affliction, when we are being afflicted, we will seek God’s face.

To seek him early means to seek him before it is too late: before you die, before judgment comes. So God is allowing Trump to do all these things in the black community with these ICE agents, for you to seek him.

“Therefore their days did he consume in vanity, and their years in trouble.” The trouble is affliction. “When he slew them, then they sought him: and they returned and enquired early after God.” What do you see taking place all over the streets right now? Oppression. Our people are being locked up and put in prison by the ICE officers. When he slew us, then we sought God and returned and enquired early after him.

God had to make bad things happen. It is the same thing in these last days, and it is why judgment first and foremost has to start at the house of the Lord: for us to seek God, and also to prove us.

“And they remembered that God was their rock, and the high God their redeemer.” He is our rock, and he is the one who is going to redeem us from the condition that we are in.

“And though the Lord give you the bread of adversity, and the water of affliction”. Who is giving the bread of adversity? The Lord. Who is allowing ICE officers to run down on our people? The Lord. Why? Because you too damn comfortable here in America, worshipping the white man, worshipping idols and being wicked. The water of affliction is the tears running down our people’s eyes in these videos, brothers and sisters crying because they thought America was about opportunity and the American dream. The tears are not going to stop; it is the beginning of sorrows. If you think it is bad now, wait: in 2026 you are going to see things take place worse than the ’40s, ’50s and ’60s.

“Yet shall not thy teachers be removed into a corner any more, but thine eyes shall see thy teachers”. As our people are being afflicted, it is our job as teachers and prophets to go and meet them and show them why it is happening: because they turned against their God. The teachers have to be there while the affliction is going on. People are not going to just wake up and seek God early; as the affliction takes place, they will see us.

“And thine ears shall hear a word behind thee, saying, This is the way, walk ye in it, when ye turn to the right hand, and when ye turn to the left.” We will be saying, This is the way: come out of Christianity, you are an Israelite, repent and keep God’s commandments. So as the ICE raids and all of this go on, brothers, let’s go hard and let our people know why these things are happening.

“Ye shall defile also the covering of thy graven images of silver, and the ornament of thy molten images of gold: thou shalt cast them away as a menstruous cloth”. The people will repent and defile their graven image, the white image of Christ. How many times have we seen them take off the cross and the Jesus piece and throw it away when they hear the teaching? They will cast away Christianity, being a Muslim and all these things as a menstruous cloth, a bloody cloth, something filthy.

The Most High is a mastermind. Y’all don’t listen? I am going to whoop y’all behind, and as I do, I will send my teachers to let you know why, and you are going to repent and come out of all these lies. So as these things happen it is our job to go harder: with the word of God, not with guns. You cannot fight the white man; any man who tells you to take up guns and fight the government is trying to get us killed, because they want our people to act up so they can bring in the Insurrection Act. The word of God is what is going to change our people and bring destruction on this place. Christianity cannot help you in these last days; all the churches teach is to love your oppressor and love white Jesus.

sense.text:
The Most High does not make judgment without two or three witnesses, and as it is done in heaven, so it is on the earth. “One witness shall not rise up against a man for any iniquity, or for any sin, in any sin that he sinneth”. No one person can rise up and accuse you of anything, because that one person could be lying.

“At the mouth of two witnesses, or at the mouth of three witnesses, shall the matter be established.” That is God’s law: with two or three witnesses you can establish facts and make judgment. Two witnesses could be liars too, and that is why there is a diligent inquisition. This is much heavier than we think, and it goes into the judgment that is coming on the earth.
“If a false witness rise up against any man to testify against him that which is wrong”: a false witness rises up and lies on you.
“Then both the men, between whom the controversy is, shall stand before the Lord, before the priests and the judges, which shall be in those days”. Now both must go before the priests and the judges.

“And the judges shall make diligent inquisition”. That is the investigation: you question one by himself, then another by himself, and different people, to find out who is lying. “And, behold, if the witness be a false witness, and hath testified falsely against his brother”: the inquisition shows that the witness lied on his brother.

“Then shall ye do unto him, as he had thought to have done unto his brother”. If you bear false witness and say, That brother committed adultery, I saw him with sister so-and-so, the judgment for that is death. If the inquisition finds the witness is a liar, that witness has to be put to death. Whatever judgment you wanted done to him, because you hate him, is done to you.

“So shalt thou put the evil away from among you.” Make that negro an example. That is how evil is put away from Israel, for people to stop lying and running with slander.

A false witness is also called slander, and another word for it is defamation. We do not have power to institute the law today, but Esau’s court system has defamation. When our sister in London, Joy Morgan, died, people said IUIC killed her and was hiding evidence; the police and investigators found we had nothing to do with it and that the man who did it was evil. When a captain of ours defended himself and his wife at the movies in Memphis, men from the UPK camp ran with one man’s story; the cameras and text messages showed the other man was the aggressor, and all the charges were dropped. Cameras don’t lie: everyone who watches sees the same thing. These men made their judgment off one witness, and that witness lied.

As the leader is, so are the officers and so are the men. The leader of that camp sat and listened to a sister who had been put out of the Jersey school, telling outrageous lies about wives and servant wives, things every one of us knows are not happening, and he enjoyed it and ran with it. As a leader you are supposed to say, I don’t believe that lie. He said it himself: we are here to down IUIC. That is why his men talk the way they do: they run with slander.

So IUIC has put out a legal notice demanding retraction and warning against defamation. When it comes to the gospel, we are not playing with slanderers anymore. Put anything out there against us that you cannot prove, and you will have to come up out of the pockets, get a lawyer and defend it. That is Christ-like, and it is about protecting the ministry of Christ, because lies are put out to blame the ministry. It will also teach men to control their mouth. Don’t make judgment without two or three witnesses, or without video, text messages or some evidence: make sure you get all the facts before you judge, or you become a slanderer and a false witness.

precepts.why:
Jehoshaphat “set judges in the land throughout all the fenced cities of Judah, city by city, And said to the judges, Take heed what ye do: for ye judge not for man, but for the Lord, who is with you in the judgment.” Take heed how you judge, brothers. Deal with matters without lying, and do not judge men wrongfully. Do not condemn anyone without two or three witnesses; that is God’s law.

When you make a judgment you are not judging for man but for the Lord. It is the Lord’s judgment you bring, because it is his law, and because the Lord is with us in the judgment it must be righteous. You cannot judge somebody because you hate him: because someone told you something about him, you believe it and run with it. That is not the judgment of the Lord.

“Wherefore now let the fear of the Lord be upon you; take heed and do it: for there is no iniquity with the Lord our God, nor respect of persons, nor taking of gifts.” Make judgment, but with the fear of the Lord, so you do not judge somebody wrongfully. Do not take gifts, and do not bend judgment because somebody is your friend or gives you things. If he goes off, you judge him the same way.

“Whoso privily slandereth his neighbour, him will I cut off”. If you slander your neighbour, God will cut you off from the book of the living. Bearing false witness is slander, and the slander that a man and his leader run with, without witnesses, puts them under this.

“He that hideth hatred with lying lips”. When somebody lies on you or slanders you, what that really shows is hatred there. “And he that uttereth a slander, is a fool.” Men from the other camps were uttering slanders against us. God says you are a fool to listen to lies, run with them and put them out there.

“A lying tongue hateth those that are afflicted by it”. If you lie on someone and run with slander, you hate the one afflicted by it. The leader of that camp said it himself: we are here to down IUIC. That is why they run with slander: it comes from hatred. As the leader is, so are the officers and so are the men.

“Strive not in a matter that concerneth thee not; and sit not in judgment with sinners.” A lot of brothers get caught up in suits striving in things that do not concern them, things they know nothing about: you just hear something and you are running your damn mouth. And do not sit in counsel with sinners, brothers that are not right, whom we put out of the school, like Titus and the rest of them. These brothers are not right.

“My son, meddle not with many matters: for if thou meddle much, thou shalt not be innocent”. This is for those who keep running their mouth about us: meddle in matters that do not concern you and you will not be innocent. That is why we take legal measures, so that when you say something, you make sure it is true.

After all of that, should we hate the men from the UPK who lie on us and try to fight us on the street corner? No. “But I say unto you which hear, Love your enemies, do good to them which hate you, Bless them that curse you, and pray for them which despitefully use you.” The enemy here is not the white man or Esau. It is your brother of your own nation and people who makes himself your enemy. They say we are their enemy; they are our brothers who do some evil things toward us and slander us. When people of your own nation curse you, bless them: Most High bless you, man. We cannot be going back and forth arguing, because the ministry will be blamed.

“And unto him that smiteth thee on the one cheek offer also the other”. That does not mean letting somebody smack you around, and it does not mean being a punk. A smack is a hurt: if somebody hurts you and you forgive him, he could hurt you again. You have to be able to forgive your brother. Come out of Christianity.

The order is: when you see them, shalom them and keep it moving. If they come at your spot, record it, tell them, Brothers, you all wrong, Most High Christ bless, and go somewhere else and teach. You cannot reason with unreasonable men. When those brothers came to our camp spot and fought us, we restrained them and called the cops, because they are our brothers and we do not want to hurt them; even that still set a bad light on the gospel. Our people do not work well together: we hate each other, and whoever we think is better than us becomes the op. It is much more than the pride and the ego; we have to let that go. That does not make you soft or weak. Satan wants us out there fighting each other; it is ego, and as men of God we have to control our ego.

“For if ye love them which love you, what thank have ye? for sinners also love those that love them.” Gang members love each other and ride and die for each other; what makes you different? Should we love only the brothers saying IUIC and to hell with everybody else? No.

“And if ye do good to them which do good to you, what thank have ye? for sinners also do even the same. And if ye lend to them of whom ye hope to receive, what thank have ye? for sinners also lend to sinners, to receive as much again.” It is easy to love them that love you. The hard thing is to love somebody that hates you. Once at Barclays Center there were men who talked crap about us all the time, and the thought was, to hell with them, I am not saluting them. Bishop cursed that out: that is not what the scripture says; the scripture says you have to love them. Our flesh thinks that way, but this truth is about growth: when you see things in you that need fixing, fix them. King David loved Saul even while Saul was trying to kill him; that is the level.

“But love ye your enemies, and do good, and lend, hoping for nothing again; and your reward shall be great”. Your enemy here is your own people that hate you. We have to learn to love our brothers that hate us, because they might repent and change, as Paul, who had a part in Stephen being killed, repented down the line. None of us should carry hatred toward the men of the UPK or any other Israelite group. If they have that spirit toward you, do not push the same spirit toward them.

sense.text: This is judgment going on in the congregation. “Moreover if thy brother shall trespass against thee, go and tell him his fault between thee and him alone”. If one of us has a problem with another, you go to that person and speak to him. “If he shall hear thee, thou hast gained thy brother.” That is what you have to try to do: win your brother.

“But if he will not hear thee, then take with thee one or two more”. Why one or two more? Because you need witnesses. God does not bring forth judgment without two or three witnesses: “that in the mouth of two or three witnesses every word may be established.” That is saying something heavy.

“And if he shall neglect to hear them, tell it unto the church: but if he neglect to hear the church, let him be unto thee as an heathen man and a publican.” The witnesses examine the matter and say, Brother, you wrong. If he will not listen to them, it goes before the church, and if he will not hear the church, you cut him off and do not deal with him, because he does not want to change, acknowledge his fault and repent. If everybody tells you that you are wrong and you still go against it, you are condemning yourself. That is the power two or three witnesses have: the power to bring condemnation on you.

“Whatsoever ye shall bind on earth shall be bound in heaven”. To bind on earth is the judgment you bring forth on earth. If you put a brother out of the church because he is not right, it is bound in heaven. “And whatsoever ye shall loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven”: the brothers and sisters you forgive are forgiven in heaven. Two or three witnesses have the power to bind things on earth and to loose things on earth.

“If two of you shall agree on earth as touching any thing that they shall ask, it shall be done for them of my Father which is in heaven.” That is the power of two witnesses. When two or three witnesses make a judgment on the earth, the Most High respects that same judgment in the heavens, because when we judge matters, the judgment we are really making is the Lord’s judgment.

“For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there am I in the midst of them.” It is the same thing we read in Chronicles: the Lord is there in the midst of us when we make judgment, because the judgment is the Lord’s.

precepts.why:
God does not bring forth judgment on the earth without two or three witnesses. Before he destroyed Jerusalem in the past, he sent two witnesses. “After these things the Lord appointed other seventy also, and sent them two and two before his face into every city and place, whither he himself would come.” After he sent out the twelve, Christ sent out the seventy two by two. Why in twos? Because you cannot make judgment with one. They are witnesses. As they went out teaching the gospel, they were bringing forth judgment on the earth, and to bring forth judgment you need two witnesses.

“And into whatsoever house ye enter, first say, Peace be to this house. And if the son of peace be there, your peace shall rest upon it: if not, it shall turn to you again.” They did not go to just any house: it speaks of people who heard the word and repented, where his spirit is. If not, you take your peace back.

“But into whatsoever city ye enter, and they receive you not, go your ways out into the streets of the same, and say, Even the very dust of your city, which cleaveth on us, we do wipe off against you”. We do the same today, teaching in the streets. What are those two witnesses doing? Teaching, and bringing forth judgment: condemning that city because the people are against the word of God. “Notwithstanding be ye sure of this”: be sure when you bring forth judgment, because that is how powerful it is. “It shall be more tolerable in that day for Sodom, than for that city.” They are marking that city, and everyone in it is condemned. They are binding people on the earth.

“Woe unto thee, Chorazin! woe unto thee, Bethsaida!” The judgment spoken of is Christ’s return in the future, not that time. “He that heareth you heareth me; and he that despiseth you despiseth me”. When people hate you, it is not really you they hate; they hate Christ.

“And the seventy returned again with joy, saying, Lord, even the devils are subject unto us through thy name.” They went out teaching repentance, binding and loosing on the earth, and those who did not repent they were marking for death. “I beheld Satan as lightning fall from heaven.” When Christ sent forth the men in twos to teach, that began the fall of this wicked kingdom. It goes back to Revelation 12, the war in heaven: Christ coming to destroy America, all Edom, in the last days, and that spiritual demon Satan.

“Behold, I give unto you power to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy: and nothing shall by any means hurt you.” That power is the Holy Spirit.

sense.text:
Christ sent out the apostles and the seventy in twos because you need two witnesses to bring forth judgment. “And I will give power unto my two witnesses, and they shall prophesy a thousand two hundred and threescore days”. These two witnesses are the two major prophets, Moses and Elijah. But they also speak of Israel as a whole: the Most High always sends forth his prophets in twos before he brings forth judgment. Read through history and you will find two prophets always coming before judgment.

A witness has a testimony, and a witness testifies, like a witness of a crime in a court of law. We are God’s witnesses on this earth, and we do not play a small role. The testimony we testify is what is written: what the prophets said is going to happen.

precepts.why: “For thy help will I send my servants”: God said he would send Isaiah and Jeremiah. Isaiah and Jeremiah came and prophesied before Babylon came and destroyed Jerusalem. God always sends forth witnesses before he brings forth judgment.

“What are these two olive trees upon the right side of the candlestick and upon the left side thereof?” and “What be these two olive branches which through the two golden pipes empty the golden oil out of themselves?” The oil is understanding.

“These are the two anointed ones, that stand by the Lord of the whole earth.” The two anointed ones are the two witnesses. At that time they were Joshua the priest and Zerubbabel. We read of Isaiah and Jeremiah, here of Joshua and Zerubbabel, and in Revelation 11 of Moses and Elijah: different names and different people, because God always sends his prophets forth in twos. When those witnesses come, they bind and loose things on earth: they forgive and they condemn, because it is the Lord speaking through them.

“Let all the nations be gathered together, and let the people be assembled: who among them can declare this, and shew us former things? let them bring forth their witnesses, that they may be justified: or let them hear, and say, It is truth.”

“Ye are my witnesses, saith the Lord, and my servant whom I have chosen”. The Lord says we are his witnesses, the ones he has chosen. God’s witnesses on this earth are the children of Israel. The two sticks, the stick of Judah and the stick of Ephraim, the northern kingdom and the southern kingdom, are two witnesses also.

“To the law and to the testimony: if they speak not according to this word, it is because there is no light in them.” As God’s witnesses, what we are supposed to testify is the law and the testimonies.

“Fill Sion with thine unspeakable oracles, and thy people with thy glory. Give testimony unto those that thou hast possessed from the beginning, and raise up prophets that have been in thy name.”

The testimony is what God gave to Moses, Isaiah, Jeremiah, Nahum, Micah, and to Peter, Paul and the apostles: all the things these men wrote. They are testimonies of things that are going to happen in the future, of what is going to happen to the children of Israel. So when the scripture says we as witnesses have to testify, our testimony is what is written, what the prophets said is going to happen.

John “bare record of the word of God, and of the testimony of Jesus Christ, and of all things that he saw.” John the Revelator saw things and wrote them down. That is the testimony we are supposed to be speaking about.

“I know thy works, and tribulation, and poverty, (but thou art rich)”: the real Jews are in a low state today. “And I know the blasphemy of them which say they are Jews, and are not”. This is one of the testimonies you are supposed to testify on the earth today: to identify the people that say they are Jews and are not. Reading this is you testifying that these people are not the people of God.

“Behold, I will make them of the synagogue of Satan, which say they are Jews, and are not, but do lie; behold, I will make them to come and worship before thy feet”. That is a testimony, and we as God’s witnesses have to testify these things on the earth today.

“Whereas Edom saith, We are impoverished, but we will return and build the desolate places; thus saith the Lord of hosts, They shall build, but I will throw down”. This is the testimony God gave Malachi: Esau is going to rebuild, but when the Lord comes back he will destroy all the cities Esau builds.

“And they shall call them, The border of wickedness, and, The people against whom the Lord hath indignation for ever.” The they is the witnesses, the prophets. We are going to let the Caucasian race know that they are the people God hates forever. That is you testifying; that is the law and the testimony.

sense.text: “For the mystery of iniquity doth already work”. This is Rome, already at work in the apostles’ time. “Only he who now letteth will let, until he be taken out of the way”: Rome is the one to be taken out of the way.

“And then shall that Wicked be revealed”. Why does the Wicked need to be revealed? Because the Wicked does not put himself up as the wicked. Today the wicked of the earth is the one you think is righteous; he has transformed into an angel of light, into Lucifer. He is on this earth hiding, but God’s witnesses, the Israelites and the prophets waking up, will testify who the wicked is and reveal him. The so-called white man, the nation of Edom, is the people God hates, the wicked the Bible talks about. For years we have been saying this; now he is showing you who he is.

“Whom the Lord shall consume with the spirit of his mouth, and shall destroy with the brightness of his coming”. Two things happen: the Lord consumes him with the spirit of his mouth, and destroys him with the brightness of his coming. The spirit of the Lord’s mouth is us teaching. That is where judgment begins: when you speak, the Lord is speaking through you, because the spirit of the Lord dwells in you.

precepts.why: “For I will give you a mouth and wisdom, which all your adversaries shall not be able to gainsay nor resist.” That mouth and wisdom is Christ speaking through us, the Holy Spirit dwelling in us. Nobody can gainsay us; that is the kind of power the Lord has given us. That is the spirit of his mouth.

“And ye shall be brought before governors and kings for my sake, for a testimony against them and the Gentiles.” The testimony is us teaching the Bible, the laws and the testimonies: letting them know God is coming back to destroy them, that they are wicked, that they have been stealing land and murdering, that they are the wicked of the earth. That testimony is what is written in this Bible.

In testifying, we are condemning them. When you testify on this earth you are condemning people: everybody that hears the word of God and turns his back on it is condemned. The Lord is going to judge Edom and Amalek and the people that call themselves Jews and are not. We are bringing forth judgment on the earth, and as you teach the word of God, they are being consumed with the spirit of the Lord’s mouth.

“But when they deliver you up, take no thought how or what ye shall speak: for it shall be given you in that same hour what ye shall speak. For it is not ye that speak, but the Spirit of your Father which speaketh in you.” Don’t worry what you are going to say when they deliver you up to be afflicted. It will no longer be you speaking. The Lord will take over: Move out of the way, Malachi, let me take over this. It will be the Lord judging them with your voice. That is why the judgment is of the Lord. So make sure you keep the commandments and do what is right, so he can use you.
“Then saw I a dream, and, behold, there came up from the sea an eagle”. This eagle is Rome, and Europe and America are an extension of this eagle, an extension of Rome.

This is the wicked being consumed with the spirit of God’s mouth. “And I beheld, and, lo, as it were a roaring lion chased out of the wood: and I saw that he sent out a man’s voice unto the eagle”. The roaring lion is Christ, but first it speaks of us, the prophets. The man’s voice speaking to the eagle, “Hear thou, I will talk with thee”, is the prophets, the witnesses on the earth today, condemning the so-called white man, Edom, for all the evil he has done on the earth through the centuries. Do you think God forgave him for slavery, for Jim Crow, for the Roman Empire destroying us in Jerusalem, exiling us and murdering us? No. God does not forget.

“And the Highest shall say unto thee”: the spirit of the Lord speaking through us. “Whom I made to reign in my world, that the end of their times might come through them”. We will be able to identify the remnant of the fourth beast on this earth. God made the white man rule. The end of their times comes through them: they will make weapons of mass destruction that bring such destruction on the earth that the Lord has to get involved. In the midst of World War III, Christ returns.

“And the fourth came, and overcame all the beasts that were past, and had power over the world with great fearfulness, and over the whole compass of the earth with much wicked oppression; and so long time dwelt he upon the earth with deceit.” The fourth is Rome, running all the way to Europe and America, who have power over the world, and everybody fears them. Esau deals with much wicked oppression on this earth, and he rules with deceit: he set himself up as the Jews, the people of God, and acts righteous while he robs and steals the resources of Africa. It is our job to reveal him. The witnesses have to prophesy before God brings forth judgment, the same way witnesses bring forth their testimony in a court of law before judgment comes.

“For the earth hast thou not judged with truth. For thou hast afflicted the meek, thou hast hurt the peaceable, thou hast loved liars, and destroyed the dwellings of them that brought forth fruit and hast cast down the walls of such as did thee no harm.” They will destroy us in the future, worse than Tulsa and Black Wall Street, and destroy cities on this earth as they did to Palestine.

“Therefore is thy wrongful dealing come up unto the Highest, and thy pride unto the Mighty.” Edom’s wrongful dealing goes before God. “The Highest also hath looked upon the proud times, and, behold, they are ended, and his abominations are fulfilled. And therefore appear no more, thou eagle, nor thy horrible wings, nor thy wicked feathers, nor thy malicious heads, nor thy hurtful claws”. The Lord is going to get rid of Edom, Esau, the white man: his military and his governments appear no more. That is the spirit of the Lord’s mouth: us teaching.

sense.text:
“And I will give power unto my two witnesses”. The two witnesses are Elijah and Moses, but also the two kingdoms, the southern kingdom and the northern kingdom. The power is the Holy Spirit, the same power he gave the apostles and the seventy in the past.

“And they shall prophesy a thousand two hundred and threescore days, clothed in sackcloth.” Another word for prophesy is testify. The whole world is our courtroom, and we are testifying.
“These are the two olive trees, and the two candlesticks standing before the God of the earth.” These are the two witnesses.

“And if any man will hurt them, fire proceedeth out of their mouth, and devoureth their enemies”. Esau does not want judgment to come on him, so he will try to kill the witnesses so they cannot testify against him, because when the witnesses testify, judgment comes. As we teach his word, they will try to kill us.

The fire out of their mouth is God’s word. Every last one of our enemies will be destroyed with fire when Christ returns, because as we teach the word of God we are marking them for destruction. “And if any man will hurt them, he must in this manner be killed”: that is how they will die when Christ returns.

“These have power to shut heaven, that it rain not in the days of their prophecy: and have power over waters to turn them to blood, and to smite the earth with all plagues, as often as they will.” As often as they prophesy, the earth is smitten with plagues.

“And when they shall have finished their testimony, the beast that ascendeth out of the bottomless pit shall make war against them, and shall overcome them, and kill them.” The beast is Edom. After we finish testifying, they will make war with us and kill us because of our testimony. And what do we testify? The laws and the testimonies, everything the prophets say, revealing who Edom is and who the synagogue of Satan is. We are judging everybody on the earth.

precepts.why:
“And they overcame him by the blood of the Lamb, and by the word of their testimony”. We are going to overcome the beast, which is the white man, Edom, by the blood of Christ and by the word of our testimony.

The testimony we have is the words of the prophets: we will be teaching the laws and the words of the prophets, and that is how we overcome this wicked society. The blood of Christ means Christ having mercy on us. If you make a mistake, fix it; if you are struggling with things inside, fix it; if you fall, get back up. Christ will have mercy on you, but you have to have his testimony.

What is the fire that proceeds out of their mouth? “Is not my word like as a fire? saith the Lord; and like a hammer that breaketh the rock in pieces?” God’s word is like fire. It goes back to the same thing in Thessalonians: the Lord consuming the wicked with the spirit of his mouth.

“And the dragon was wroth with the woman, and went to make war with the remnant of her seed, which keep the commandments of God”. The dragon is Edom. It goes back to after we finish testifying: they will kill those of us that keep the commandments, that testify and teach the laws and the testimonies.

“Rejoice over her, thou heaven, and ye holy apostles and prophets; for God hath avenged you on her.” The apostles and prophets are here in America today, all twelve of them, and they will be teaching. After they finish their testimony, they will be killed. Before Babylon is destroyed, most of the apostles will be dead; the only one who might not be is John the Revelator.

“And in her was found the blood of prophets, and of saints, and of all that were slain upon the earth.” Her is Babylon, America. Why would they kill the prophets here? Because the prophets will be testifying against them, reading the Bible and revealing them: this is you Isaiah talks about; you are the wicked of the earth; you are the synagogue of Satan.

As we judge them and testify, the whole earth is our courtroom, and judgment is going to come. That is why the gospel has to be taught throughout the whole world and then the end comes: we are testifying against everyone. It is to wake up our people that are scattered, but it is also to condemn the wicked.

“And after that I looked, and, behold, the temple of the tabernacle of the testimony in heaven was opened”. The testimony, everything the prophets wrote, is also in heaven, and it is opened: we are understanding it and teaching it.

“And the seven angels came out of the temple, having the seven plagues”, and “one of the four beasts gave unto the seven angels seven golden vials full of the wrath of God”. The testimonies also go into the things the Lord is going to do on the earth: the judgment and death that have to take place.

“And I heard a great voice out of the temple saying to the seven angels, Go your ways, and pour out the vials of the wrath of God upon the earth.” The vials are poured out on the earth, but for that to happen something has to come first: the prophets must testify.

“Will a lion roar in the forest, when he hath no prey?” It is the same lion we read of in Ezra, roaring and chasing the eagle out of the wood.

“Shall a trumpet be blown in the city, and the people not be afraid?” The trumpet is the witnesses, us teaching. When we blow that trumpet and testify, the people had better be afraid. “Shall there be evil in a city, and the Lord hath not done it?” The Lord is the one behind it, through the angels with the seven last plagues and the wrath of God poured out on the earth.

“Surely the Lord God will do nothing, but he revealeth his secret unto his servants the prophets.” The prophets are his witnesses, and his secret is his testimonies. When he reveals them to us, we are supposed to testify. “The lion hath roared, who will not fear? the Lord God hath spoken, who can but prophesy?” The lion roaring is Christ speaking to us, and when the Lord God speaks, his servants prophesy, or testify.

“Publish in the palaces at Ashdod, and in the palaces in the land of Egypt”. He is telling us who to prophesy against. Ashdod is in the land of Israel, by modern-day Tel Aviv. The land of Egypt is America: we have to testify here also.

“Who art thou, O great mountain? before Zerubbabel thou shalt become a plain”. That great mountain is America, and it lets you know Zerubbabel will be here in the last days prophesying and testifying. “And he shall bring forth the headstone thereof with shoutings, crying, Grace, grace unto it.” The headstone is Christ. The shoutings are him testifying and prophesying, and the grace is the cry: Israel, repent.

“The hands of Zerubbabel have laid the foundation of this house; his hands shall also finish it”. That speaks of the future, the last days we are living in. Zerubbabel means born in Babylon. Zerubbabel is here, born in Babylon, and he is no regular prophet.

“For who hath despised the day of small things? for they shall rejoice, and shall see the plummet in the hand of Zerubbabel with those seven”. Those seven are the seven archangels with the seven last plagues to destroy Babylon. As Zerubbabel testifies and prophesies, those angels bring forth destruction on the earth.
